knowledge_contract.knows_references: Order IDs only; absence of an order is not knowledge of its nonexistence. knows lists are in ID order (first-listed = lowest ID).
knowledge_contract.coordinates: Evaluator-only. Never give world coordinates, box IDs, all-box lists, oracle or baseline to the LLM.
knowledge_contract.yaw: bisector of the bearings to all boxes; every box within 70 deg of it

model.pickup_formula: 58*d/0.8 after the 12 s survey; d = start-to-box distance (analytical proxy only, DESIGN-18)
model.door_rule: The 8 s exclusive slot is inside the 110 s carry; FCFS, ties r1; queue delay shifts the rest of the carry and the set-down.
model.note: No second carry in v2 (no return/repeat pickup); DESIGN-18 return_s and repeat_pickup_s do not apply.
model.count_rule: Sum over orders of min(count, boxes of that colour set down at that sign); unmatched deliveries are errors (unordered move).
model.upper_definition: Omniscient plan: maximise correct boxes, then minimise completion, then prefer plans where each robot carries an order it knows. Not a measured minimum.
model.time_rule: Unmet demand counts 900 s in *_capped_completion_s; baseline_active_end_s is the end of the last acting robot.

baseline_rules.B: No messages. A robot that knows >=1 order picks one of its known orders, takes the nearest box of that colour and sets it down at that order's sign (one carry only). A robot that knows no order does nothing.
baseline_rules.primary: baseline_correct and all baseline_* time fields: the pick among known orders is UNIFORM (position-free expectation, exact enumeration of all joint choices). This is the gap filter.
baseline_rules.first_listed: baseline_plan and baseline_first_listed_*: the pick is knows[rid][0] (DESIGN-18 lowest-ID rule; lists are in ID order). Diagnostic only: with first-listed balance it equals the oracle in half of the C scenes.
baseline_rules.guess: baseline_guess_*: like primary, but a robot with no order takes its nearest box (any colour) and a uniformly random sign. Wrong boxes cost no points under the count rule but count as errors (unordered move).
baseline_rules.conflict: Two robots choosing the same box: earlier arrival keeps it; the other re-surveys 12 s at that box and takes the nearest box nobody chose (same colour if informed), or nothing.
baseline_rules.time_model: DESIGN-18: survey 12 s, pick 58*d/0.8 s, carry 110 s (door entry +40 s, 8 s slot, FCFS, ties r1), set-down 10 s; unmet demand counts 900 s in *_capped_completion_s.

selection_rule: L and C keep a scene only if oracle - baseline >= 0.5 correct boxes under BOTH the primary (uniform) and the guess baseline; X and D are equal-count controls (control=true).
